# Eclectik

> Independent AI transformation assurance: we measure whether AI investments deliver, in the P&L and in how people actually work.

Three commitments. Agnostic: we do not sell or resell what we measure, and no licence revenue rides on the answer. Independent: we did not build your rollout. Scientific: cohorts are named in advance, one stable outcome definition holds, and the estimator is chosen up front.

Two proofs. Proof of Value: ROI, TCO and adoption economics modelled on the organisation's own licence, usage and telemetry data, for CFOs and CIOs. Proof of Change: people-science reading of listening data, whatever instrument the organisation runs, for transformation leaders.

We also run Customer Success and People Science for organisations on Viva Glint and on Workvivo Seer, independently of the platform vendor.

Partners deliver the transformation; we prove whether it works. Microsoft partner (UK, CH, NL, US). ISO 27001 certified.

Trusted partners include Alex Lee, EFTA, IMC, Almirall, TD Industries, Warburtons, Westfalen, Breitling, and Pepkor.

## The two proofs

- [Proof of Value](https://www.eclectik.co/proof-of-value): ROI, TCO and adoption economics modelled on your own licence, usage and telemetry data, with counterfactual estimation, for CFOs and CIOs. The full page opens in November 2026.
- [Proof of Change](https://www.eclectik.co/proof-of-change): a people-science reading of your listening data, whatever instrument you run, showing where AI lands as a resource and where it lands as an extra demand. The full page opens in November 2026.

## Services

- [Consulting](https://www.eclectik.co/consulting): Advisory that stays on the measurement side. We advise on one question: is your AI transformation delivering, and what should change so it does. We do not build rollouts and we do not sell licences.
- [HR Tech Services](https://www.eclectik.co/hrtechservices): Independent Customer Success and People Science for organisations on Viva Glint or Workvivo Seer.
- [Glint Support](https://www.eclectik.co/glint-support): Independent Customer Success and People Science for organisations running Viva Glint: cycle design, programme delivery, manager enablement and turning results into movement.
- [Workvivo and Seer](https://www.eclectik.co/workvivo): Workvivo and Seer partner page. Adoption and activation measurement, communication impact analysis, Seer-certified survey onboarding and programme design, and a four to six week execution gap assessment that quantifies the distance between feedback given and change seen.

## Assess your own transformation

- [AI Transformation Scorecard](https://www.eclectik.co/scorecard): a free 23-question self-assessment, three to four minutes, with an instant readiness profile.
- [The AI transformation benchmark](https://www.eclectik.co/benchmark): standardised KPIs, process-level measurement and peer comparison across organisations. Opens November 2026; the waiting list hears first.
